name: Gino Kwok
office: Hacienda La Puente Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Gino Kwok is a trial attorney and incumbent member of the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Board of Education for Trustee Area 4. He has served as board president and graduated from the district’s schools and USC Law School.

sentences.text: Gino Kwok is a trial attorney and incumbent member of the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Board of Education for Trustee Area 4.
He has served as board president and graduated from the district’s schools and USC Law School.

items.text: On the board, he helped create a summer middle-school math enrichment program, start and expand Spanish, Chinese and Korean dual-language immersion programs, and lead a $45 million capital improvement project for district schools. In 2025, he voted to appoint John Roach as district superintendent. In 2022, he said he wanted to apply his background in public education and law to address the pandemic's long-term mental, emotional and physical effects on students.
